translations.web: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.
translations.bsb: You are to make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle—eleven curtains in all.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
translations.asv: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make them.
